# IVX iOS Simulator QA — GitHub Actions macOS Runner
#
# Runs on GitHub's macOS-latest runner with Xcode pre-installed.
# Builds the Expo iOS simulator app, boots a real iOS Simulator,
# installs the app, takes screenshots, and runs Maestro flows.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files or Maestro flows change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
#
# Secrets required (already configured in repo):
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
#
# Secret required for full 20-step chat QA (owner must add):
#   - OWNER_PASSWORD — owner's Supabase password for app login
#
# Artifacts uploaded:
#   - Screenshots (launch, post-test)
#   - Build log
#   - Simulator logs
#   - Maestro JUnit results
#   - Xcode scheme listing

name: iOS Simulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - '.github/workflows/ios-simulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full 20-step chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: iOS Simulator Build + Maestro QA
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
      app_path: ${{ steps.app.outputs.path }}
      simulator_id: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_id }}
      simulator_name: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_name }}
      ios_version: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.ios_version }}
      maestro_launch_result: ${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}
      maestro_chat_result: ${{ steps.maestro-chat.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile || bun install

      - name: Expo prebuild (generate native iOS project)
        working-directory: expo
        run: npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Install CocoaPods
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: pod install --repo-update

      - name: Discover Xcode workspace and scheme
        id: xcode
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: |
          WORKSPACE=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.xcworkspace" | head -1)
          echo "workspace=$WORKSPACE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Workspace: $WORKSPACE"
          xcodebuild -list -workspace "$WORKSPACE" 2>&1 | tee xcode-list.log
          SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -list -workspace "$WORKSPACE" 2>&1 | awk '/Schemes:/{getline; print}' | xargs)
          echo "scheme=$SCHEME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Scheme: $SCHEME"

      - name: Build iOS simulator app
        id: build
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcodebuild \
            -workspace "${{ steps.xcode.outputs.workspace }}" \
            -scheme "${{ steps.xcode.outputs.scheme }}" \
            -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -configuration Debug \
            -derivedDataPath build \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
            CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" \
            2>&1 | tee build.log
          echo "Build completed successfully"

      - name: Find built .app bundle
        id: app
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: |
          APP_PATH=$(find build/Build/Products -name "*.app" -type d | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::No .app bundle found in build output"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "path=$APP_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "App bundle: $APP_PATH"

      - name: Boot iOS Simulator
        id: sim
        run: |
          # Find the first available iPhone simulator
          SIM_INFO=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | python3 -c "
          import json, sys
          data = json.load(sys.stdin)
          for runtime, devices in data['devices'].items():
              if 'iOS' in runtime:
                  for d in devices:
                      if 'iPhone' in d['name'] and d['isAvailable']:
                          print(json.dumps({'udid': d['udid'], 'name': d['name'], 'runtime': runtime}))
                          sys.exit(0)
          ")
          SIM_ID=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['udid'])")
          SIM_NAME=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['name'])")
          SIM_RUNTIME=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['runtime'])")
          IOS_VERSION=$(echo "$SIM_RUNTIME" | sed 's/.*iOS-//')

          echo "sim_id=$SIM_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "sim_name=$SIM_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "ios_version=$IOS_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "Booting simulator: $SIM_NAME (iOS $IOS_VERSION, UDID: $SIM_ID)"
          xcrun simctl boot "$SIM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
          xcrun simctl bootstatus "$SIM_ID" -b

      - name: Install app on simulator
        run: |
          xcrun simctl install booted "${{ steps.app.outputs.path }}"
          echo "App installed on simulator"

      - name: Launch app and capture screenshot
        run: |
          xcrun simctl launch booted com.ivxholdings.app
          sleep 10
          xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshot-01-launch.png
          echo "Launch screenshot saved"

      - name: Capture simulator system log
        run: |
          xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --level info --predicate 'process == "IVXHoldings" OR process == "ivxholdings"' --timeout 5 > simulator-app.log 2>&1 || true
          xcrun simctl spawn booted log show --predicate 'process == "IVXHoldings" OR process == "ivxholdings"' --last 5m > simulator-log-history.txt 2>&1 || true

      - name: Install Maestro
        run: |
          curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
          echo "$HOME/.maestro/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          maestro --version

      - name: Run Maestro launch test (no auth required)
        id: maestro-launch
        working-directory: expo
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          maestro test .maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-launch-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-launch.log
          echo "Maestro launch test completed"

      - name: Run full 20-step chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)
        id: maestro-chat
        working-directory: expo
        env:
          OWNER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OWNER_PASSWORD }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -z "$OWNER_PASSWORD" ] && [ "${{ github.event.inputs.run_full_qa }}" != "true" ]; then
            echo "OWNER_PASSWORD secret not set — full 20-step chat QA skipped"
            echo "To enable: add OWNER_PASSWORD as a GitHub repository secret"
            echo "result=skipped" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0

{"content": "# IVX iOS Simulator QA — GitHub Actions macOS Runner
#
# Runs on GitHub's macOS-latest runner with Xcode pre-installed.
# Builds the Expo iOS simulator app, boots a real iOS Simulator,
# installs the app, takes screenshots, and runs Maestro flows.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files or Maestro flows change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
#
# Secrets required (already configured in repo):
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
#   - EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
#
# Secret required for full 20-step chat QA (owner must add):
#   - OWNER_PASSWORD — owner's Supabase password for app login
#
# Artifacts uploaded:
#   - Screenshots (launch, post-test)
#   - Build log
#   - Simulator logs
#   - Maestro JUnit results
#   - Xcode scheme listing

name: iOS Simulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - '.github/workflows/ios-simulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full 20-step chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: iOS Simulator Build + Maestro QA
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
      app_path: ${{ steps.app.outputs.path }}
      simulator_id: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_id }}
      simulator_name: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_name }}
      ios_version: ${{ steps.sim.outputs.ios_version }}
      maestro_launch_result: ${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}
      maestro_chat_result: ${{ steps.maestro-chat.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile || bun install

      - name: Expo prebuild (generate native iOS project)
        working-directory: expo
        run: npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Install CocoaPods
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: pod install --repo-update

      - name: Discover Xcode workspace and scheme
        id: xcode
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: |
          WORKSPACE=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.xcworkspace" | head -1)
          echo "workspace=$WORKSPACE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Workspace: $WORKSPACE"
          xcodebuild -list -workspace "$WORKSPACE" 2>&1 | tee xcode-list.log
          SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -list -workspace "$WORKSPACE" 2>&1 | awk '/Schemes:/{getline; print}' | xargs)
          echo "scheme=$SCHEME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Scheme: $SCHEME"

      - name: Build iOS simulator app
        id: build
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcodebuild \
            -workspace "${{ steps.xcode.outputs.workspace }}" \
            -scheme "${{ steps.xcode.outputs.scheme }}" \
            -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -configuration Debug \
            -derivedDataPath build \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
            CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" \
            2>&1 | tee build.log
          echo "Build completed successfully"

      - name: Find built .app bundle
        id: app
        working-directory: expo/ios
        run: |
          APP_PATH=$(find build/Build/Products -name "*.app" -type d | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::No .app bundle found in build output"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "path=$APP_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "App bundle: $APP_PATH"

      - name: Boot iOS Simulator
        id: sim
        run: |
          # Find the first available iPhone simulator
          SIM_INFO=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | python3 -c "
          import json, sys
          data = json.load(sys.stdin)
          for runtime, devices in data['devices'].items():
              if 'iOS' in runtime:
                  for d in devices:
                      if 'iPhone' in d['name'] and d['isAvailable']:
                          print(json.dumps({'udid': d['udid'], 'name': d['name'], 'runtime': runtime}))
                          sys.exit(0)
          ")
          SIM_ID=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['udid'])")
          SIM_NAME=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['name'])")
          SIM_RUNTIME=$(echo "$SIM_INFO" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['runtime'])")
          IOS_VERSION=$(echo "$SIM_RUNTIME" | sed 's/.*iOS-//')

          echo "sim_id=$SIM_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "sim_name=$SIM_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "ios_version=$IOS_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "Booting simulator: $SIM_NAME (iOS $IOS_VERSION, UDID: $SIM_ID)"
          xcrun simctl boot "$SIM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
          xcrun simctl bootstatus "$SIM_ID" -b

      - name: Install app on simulator
        run: |
          xcrun simctl install booted "${{ steps.app.outputs.path }}"
          echo "App installed on simulator"

      - name: Launch app and capture screenshot
        run: |
          xcrun simctl launch booted com.ivxholdings.app
          sleep 10
          xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshot-01-launch.png
          echo "Launch screenshot saved"

      - name: Capture simulator system log
        run: |
          xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --level info --predicate 'process == "IVXHoldings" OR process == "ivxholdings"' --timeout 5 > simulator-app.log 2>&1 || true
          xcrun simctl spawn booted log show --predicate 'process == "IVXHoldings" OR process == "ivxholdings"' --last 5m > simulator-log-history.txt 2>&1 || true

      - name: Install Maestro
        run: |
          curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
          echo "$HOME/.maestro/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          maestro --version

      - name: Run Maestro launch test (no auth required)
        id: maestro-launch
        working-directory: expo
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          maestro test .maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-launch-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-launch.log
          echo "Maestro launch test completed"

      - name: Run full 20-step chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)
        id: maestro-chat
        working-directory: expo
        env:
          OWNER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OWNER_PASSWORD }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -z "$OWNER_PASSWORD" ] && [ "${{ github.event.inputs.run_full_qa }}" != "true" ]; then
            echo "OWNER_PASSWORD secret not set — full 20-step chat QA skipped"
            echo "To enable: add OWNER_PASSWORD as a GitHub repository secret"
            echo "result=skipped" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi
          maestro test .maestro/ivx-chat-full-qa.yaml --format junit --output maestro-chat-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-chat.log
          echo "result=completed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Take post-test screenshot
        run: |
          xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshot-02-post-test.png || true

      - name: Get simulator runtime info
        if: always()
        run: |
          xcrun simctl list devices -j | python3 -c "
          import json, sys
          data = json.load(sys.stdin)
          for runtime, devices in data['devices'].items():
              for d in devices:
                  if d['udid'] == '${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_id }}':
                      print(f\"Device: {d['name']}\")
                      print(f\"State: {d['state']}\")
                      print(f\"Runtime: {runtime}\")
          " > simulator-info.txt 2>&1 || true

      - name: Shutdown simulator
        if: always()
        run: |
          xcrun simctl shutdown all 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Upload all artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: ios-simulator-qa-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            screenshot-*.png
            simulator-app.log
            simulator-log-history.txt
            simulator-info.txt
            expo/ios/build.log
            expo/ios/xcode-list.log
            expo/maestro-launch-results.xml
            expo/maestro-launch.log
            expo/maestro-chat-results.xml
            expo/maestro-chat.log
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Generate QA summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## iOS Simulator QA Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Item | Value |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| --- | --- |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Commit SHA | \`${{ github.sha }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Simulator | ${{ steps.sim.outputs.sim_name }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| iOS Version | ${{ steps.sim.outputs.ios_version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Build Status | \`${{ steps.build.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Maestro Launch | \`${{ steps.maestro-launch.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Maestro Chat QA | \`${{ steps.maestro-chat.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Artifacts" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Screenshots: \`screenshot-01-launch.png\`, \`screenshot-02-post-test.png\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Build log: \`expo/ios/build.log\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Simulator logs: \`simulator-app.log\`, \`simulator-log-history.txt\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Maestro results: \`maestro-launch-results.xml\`, \`maestro-chat-results.xml\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

# IVX Chat — 20-Step Full Lifecycle QA Flow
# Required by owner: launch → login → chat open → newest visible →
# no initial jump → send → appears once → realtime reply →
# scroll older → pagination → stable position → return to latest →
# keyboard → multiline → close keyboard → background/resume →
# restart → reopen → newest still visible
#
# Run: maestro test .maestro/ivx-chat-full-qa.yaml
# Env: OWNER_EMAIL, OWNER_PASSWORD (export before running)

appId: com.ivxholdings.app
name: IVX Chat 20-Step Full Lifecycle QA
tags:
  - ios-qa
  - chat
  - full-lifecycle
  - critical

---
# ── Step 1: Launch app ──────────────────────────────────────────
- launchApp:
    clearState: true
- assertVisible:
    text: "IVX"
    timeout: 30000

# ── Step 2: Owner login ─────────────────────────────────────────
- tapOn:
    id: "home-owner-login-entry"
- assertVisible:
    text: "Owner Login"
    timeout: 5000
- tapOn:
    id: "login-email"
- inputText: ${OWNER_EMAIL}
- tapOn:
    id: "login-password"
- inputText: ${OWNER_PASSWORD}
- tapOn:
    id: "login-submit"
- assertVisible:
    text: "IVX"
    timeout: 15000

# ── Step 3: Open IVX Chat ───────────────────────────────────────
- tapOn:
    id: "tab-chat"
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-composer-dock"
    timeout: 15000

# ── Step 4: Confirm latest conversation opens ───────────────────
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-composer"
    timeout: 10000

# ── Step 5: Confirm newest message is visible ───────────────────
# The inverted FlatList anchors at the newest message on first layout.
# If the composer dock is visible and the list is loaded, the newest
# message should be at the top of the visible viewport.
- assertVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-composer-dock"
    timeout: 10000

# ── Step 6: Confirm yellow arrow is HIDDEN on initial open ──────
# The scroll-to-latest button (yellow arrow) must NOT be visible
# when the chat first opens, because the inverted list anchors at
# the newest message naturally.
- assertNotVisible:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-scroll-to-latest"
    timeout: 3000

# ── Step 7: Send a message ──────────────────────────────────────
- tapOn:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-input"
- inputText: "QA test message — automated iOS flow"
- tapOn:
    id: "ivx-owner-chat-send"

# ── Step 8: Confirm message appears exactly once ────────────────
# Wait for the message to appear in the chat list.
- assertVisible:
    text: "QA test message — automated iOS flow"
    timeout: 15000

# ── Step 9: Receive/simulate authorized realtime reply ──────────
# If the backend is online, an AI reply should appear.
# If backend is hibernating, this step may timeout — that is acceptable.
- extendedWaitUntil:
    visible:
      id: "ivx-owner-chat-composer-dock"
    timeout: 30000

# ── Step 10: Scroll to older messages ───────────────────────────
# Swipe UP to scroll toward older messages (inverted list: up = older).
- swipe:
    start: 50%,30%
    end: 50%,70%
    duration: 800

# ── Step 11: Trigger pagination ─────────────────────────────────
# Continue scrolling up to trigger the onEndReached pagination handler.
- swipe:
    start: 50%,20%
